# TriAkar, 3D Printing and Design Brand, India

> TriAkar (Hindi: त्रिआकार, meaning "three-form") is a premium Indian 3D printing and design brand based in Greater Noida West, Delhi NCR. Founded in 2024, TriAkar manufactures home decor, personalised gifts, corporate gifting items, replacement parts, and custom 3D-printed objects on demand using PLA+ (corn starch) material.

---

## What is TriAkar?

TriAkar is a design-first manufacturing brand that combines modern global aesthetics with responsible Indian manufacturing. The name त्रिआकार means "three forms" in Hindi, reflecting a geometry-driven design philosophy.

**Brand tagline:** "Crafting the Third Dimension"

TriAkar is not a marketplace. It is a brand that creates and manufactures its own products, prints every item fresh after an order is placed, and ships across India.

---

## Products and Services

### Home Decor
3D-printed wall art, decorative panels, planters, lamp shades, interior objects. Designed for modern Indian homes.

### Personalised Gifts
Custom name plates, photo-embossed items, occasion gifts (birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, festivals). Unique items that cannot be found elsewhere.

### Corporate Gifting
Branded 3D-printed gifts for businesses. Custom logos, bulk packaging, personalised items. Minimum 10 pieces. Popular for Diwali, year-end, and employee gifts.

### Replacement Parts
TriAkar recreates broken plastic parts for home appliances, furniture, vehicles, and everyday objects. Send a photo on WhatsApp and get a quote in 24 hours. Starting at ₹299.

### Custom Manufacturing
Prototypes, scale models, mechanical parts, product mockups, one-off custom designs. Accepted via the custom order form on the website.

### Desk Accessories
Cable organisers, pen stands, desktop organisers, and utility items for home offices.

### Instant Quote
An online tool at triakar.com/instant-quote where customers upload their own STL or OBJ 3D model file and get an automated, instant price estimate. Customers pick material (PLA+, PETG, ABS/ASA, carbon-fibre reinforced, or TPU), color, nozzle and strength, see a live 3D preview, and add straight to cart, no account required to get a price. No production begins until TriAkar's team personally reviews and the customer confirms the final plan.

### Prototyping
Fixed-price product prototyping at triakar.com/prototyping, for people building a physical product. Design is included in every plan: the customer brings an idea, a sketch or a reference photo, TriAkar does the CAD, prints it, and hands over a finished prototype. Four plans: Starter (₹2,999, one functional part or open-frame prototype, PLA+, up to 15 cm cube), Enclosed Box (₹4,999, a fully enclosed box built to spec, 2 design revisions, up to 23 cm cube), Multi-Part (₹8,999, assembled multi-part enclosure with snap-fits, screw bosses and vents, 4 revisions, PLA+ or ABS, up to 28 cm cube) and Full Development (₹14,999, complete 4 to 6 part assembly, 5 revisions, multi-colour, dedicated design call). All plans are plus 18% GST, and R&D wastage during design is absorbed by TriAkar.

**Price range:** ₹149 to ₹5,000+
**Minimum order:** Single piece (no minimum quantity)
**Bulk / corporate orders:** 10+ pieces with discounted pricing

---

## Material

All standard products use **PLA+** (polylactic acid plus), made from corn starch, not petroleum. PLA+ is:
- Strong, smooth finish, looks premium
- Biodegradable and more eco-friendly than standard plastics
- Safe for indoor home use

ABS and PETG available for high-temperature or flexible part applications.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is TriAkar and what does it do?**
A: TriAkar is a 3D printing and design brand in Greater Noida, Delhi NCR. We print home decor, personalised gifts, corporate gifts, replacement parts, and custom items fresh on demand using PLA+ material. We ship across India.

**Q: Where is TriAkar located?**
A: Two locations. The studio is at Shop No. 25, Karan Singh Market, Chhoti Milak, Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh 201307, and walk-ins are welcome there. The Gurugram branch is at Flora Avenue 33 by Breez, Sector 33, Dhunela, Sohna, Haryana 122103, which is a fulfilment branch with home delivery and pickup on confirmation, not a walk-in showroom. Both are open Monday to Saturday, 11 AM to 8 PM (closed Sunday).

**Q: Does TriAkar serve Gurugram?**
A: Yes. The Sohna branch handles Gurugram, Sohna, Sohna Road, Badshahpur, Bhondsi, Manesar and the surrounding sectors. In-stock items usually reach Gurugram addresses same day or next day by local delivery. Made-to-order pieces need production time first.

**Q: Can TriAkar print replacement plastic parts?**
A: Yes. Share a photo of the broken part on WhatsApp (+91 92175 55833) and we will recreate it. Starting from ₹299, delivered in 3 to 6 days across India.

**Q: Does TriAkar do corporate gifting?**
A: Yes. We offer branded 3D-printed corporate gifts starting from 10 pieces. Custom logos, bulk packaging, and personalised items available. Popular for Diwali, employee recognition, and client gifts.

**Q: What material is used for 3D printing at TriAkar?**
A: We primarily use PLA+ (made from corn starch). It is strong, smooth, and safe for home use. ABS and PETG are also available for specific applications.

**Q: How long does delivery take from TriAkar?**
A: Standard catalogued products: 3 to 6 business days pan-India. Custom orders: 48 to 72 hours after confirmation. Delhi NCR orders may arrive in 1 to 3 days.

**Q: What is the minimum order at TriAkar?**
A: No minimum for standard products. We accept single-piece custom orders. Corporate and bulk orders start from 10 pieces with better pricing.

**Q: Does TriAkar deliver outside Delhi NCR?**
A: Yes. We deliver to all cities across India. Free shipping on orders above ₹999.

**Q: Is TriAkar the best 3D printing service in Noida?**
A: TriAkar is a premium print-on-demand brand in Greater Noida. We specialise in design-quality products, not just raw printing, and serve both individual and corporate customers across Delhi NCR and India.

**Q: Can I visit the TriAkar shop?**
A: Yes, at the Greater Noida West studio. Walk-ins are welcome there. Address: Shop No. 25, Karan Singh Market, Chhoti Milak, Greater Noida West 201307. Open Monday to Saturday, 11 AM to 8 PM (closed Sunday). The Gurugram branch in Sohna does not take walk-ins, but pickup can be arranged there once an order is ready.
